auftrag: Read the timetable and the diary. Then solve four puzzles.

saetze: The nine forty-two to Brighton now leaves from platform 6.
We came to the station at half past nine.
We ran to platform 6 and jumped on the train.

raetsel.frage: When does the nine forty-two train arrive in Brighton?
raetsel.hilfe1: Find the line that starts with 09:42.
raetsel.hilfe2: Read to the end of the line. Look for the word "arrives".

raetsel.frage: True or false? “The train now leaves from platform 4.”
raetsel.rtyp: True, false or not in the text

raetsel.frage: Put the events in the right order. What happened first?
raetsel.hilfe1: Read Agent Wren's diary from top to bottom.
raetsel.hilfe2: Running comes before jumping on the train.

raetsel.frage: Agent Wren wrote a short note on the train. It has three mistakes. Can you find them?
raetsel.text: We [[goes|go|going]] to Brighton by train. The train [[leave|leaves|leaving]] at nine forty-two. Pidge [[sit|sits|sitting]] on my bag.
raetsel.hilfe1: Look at the verbs. They must fit "we", "the train" and "Pidge".
raetsel.hilfe2: "The train" and "Pidge" are one thing each. They need an -s.
